concreteFalsePass.interpretation: Reports accurately retained failures, but these failure fields do not control the deliverable gate. Render/readback success and one patch check were substituted for task-completion evidence.

rootCauses.cause: Only Fusion status/readback and added-patch static pass are asserted. Motor failures and head failures are interpolated as prose after the acceptance assertions.
Each wire defaults to adopted=True; integrationReady=False and known failures do not prevent default inclusion in a completion-oriented deliverable.
Closed head / Closed robot labels mean cap visibility, but read as enclosure success. Rear USB aperture is deliberately retained. No required-opening inventory or complete-enclosure check exists.

Changing the motor-data connection to external Mac USB was used to remove the upward Pi USB conflict; that substitutes architecture for repairing the requested internal Pi-to-OpenRB connection and complete enclosure.
Current-design command runs the old design/reach/budget baseline and does not consume the exported roof-wiring-stage manifest or route checks. Its passing exit cannot qualify this assembly revision.

New wires were first generated as illustrative polylines without obstacle-constrained construction; direct known failures were tolerated as stage output. Fixing a collision requires changing the route or confirmed placement, not adding a warning.

minimalCorrectGate.location: Existing build_review.py immediately before completion-oriented page generation, shared by prepare_fusion final handoff
minimalCorrectGate.requiredRevision: Explicit active requirement record: internal Pi-to-OpenRB USB; original outer crown and rear enclosure; complete named electrical net inventory
mechanicalConjunction: All required routes and parts bind to the exact adopted component transforms and geometry hashes
All mandatory route IDs present exactly once; both registered endpoints and conductor/return nets present
Required path/self/connector/closure/motion checks complete for the declared scope; expected tests minus completed tests must be empty
Known unintended intersections count zero; invalid boolean/open-mesh/unrun results are incomplete, not pass
Intentional inserted contacts have pair-, region-, operation- and depth-specific evidence; no global epsilon waiver
Required enclosure openings inventory matches active requirement; a patch-only static check does not prove full enclosure
No electrical architecture or component substitution is accepted solely to make the mechanical check pass
minimalCorrectGate.failureBehavior: The repair task remains active. Keep diagnostics locally and communicate progress without generating a completion title or treating an annotated failure page as the repaired handoff. Explicitly requested failure review can be shown as a diagnostic, separate from repair acceptance.
negativeControls: Restored crown with rear service aperture under fully-enclosed requirement must reject
Any one route still colliding, omitted, timed out, stale or checked against hidden obstacles must reject
Same STL with changed active port transform must reject stale route receipts
Fusion readback true plus collision report false must reject
